claims.text: Google DeepMind announced an updated Gemini 3 Deep Think on 2026-02-12 as a specialized reasoning mode for science, research, and engineering problems.
The February announcement described availability through the Gemini app for Google AI Ultra subscribers and an early-access path for API use rather than broad general API availability.
Scientific and benchmark performance results in the announcement are vendor claims unless independently reproduced.

limitations.text: Deep Think is a specialized reasoning mode, so its results should not be generalized to the entire Gemini 3 family.
Announcement-time API availability was limited/early access.
Scientific benchmark and comparison claims are vendor-reported.

claims.text: The Gemini API changelog records Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview on 2026-02-19 and a custom-tools endpoint that prioritizes user-defined tools alongside built-in execution capabilities.
The changelog records Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview (Nano Banana 2) on 2026-02-26 as a speed/high-volume image-generation release.
Performance and quality superiority claims associated with these previews remain vendor claims.

limitations.text: Both highlighted model identifiers were preview-stage February releases; drafting must not describe them as generally stable at that date.
The API changelog is chronology evidence and does not independently validate quality/benchmark claims.
